meta.ci: normal approx, mean +/- 1.96 sd/sqrt(n); paired on matched seeds
meta.recovery_steps: probes after change until first unique defect in an up-weighted family; censored runs counted at the cap (abrupt 91, delayed 46, recovery 61)
meta.diversity: normalised entropy of the 90 evaluation arm choices (ln 6 = 1)
meta.cpu_us_per_step: thread CPU time of select+update per probe incl. instrumentation overhead

stationary_exploration_check.note: descriptive, across policies (n = number of learning policies), not a causal estimate
